slides.title: Ethiopia's ministers go to a training centre
slides.body: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has put cabinet ministers through military training, allAfrica reports.

slides.title: What was reported
slides.body: Images on social media show ministers, including Finance Minister Fitsum Assefa and Health Minister Mekdes Daba, at the Hurso military training centre.

slides.title: What Abiy said
slides.body: He said military discipline can help strengthen leadership and national development, and that such institutions teach discipline, patriotism, teamwork and accountability.

slides.title: The context
slides.body: The report calls the step unusual and notes ongoing conflicts and tensions with Eritrea. Single report, not independently verified.

slides.title: Prioritize civilian protection and open dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
